text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука achieves a remarkable
victory at
the Kinko Sho. Afterwards, Air
Groove tells her
that she has become an
ideal for other
Umamusume to aspire to.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Staking her pride as Empress, Эйр Грув
declares
she'll supersede that ideal one
day and challenges
Сайленс Судзука to a
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, Эйр Грув and Сайленс Судзука
decide
the ultimate competition
between the two of
them will take place
at the Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
